items_all.title: OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna cut prices in half but barely move the needle on performance
items_all.summary: With GPT-6 Sol and Luna, OpenAI adds two cheaper models that deliver their predecessors' performance at half the token price and take aim at Anthropic's pricier offerings. Independent analyses find little gain in actual intelligence, though, and OpenAI likely didn't see Anthropic's simultaneous launch of Opus 5.5 coming. The article OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna cut prices in half but barely move the needle on performance appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 透過 GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna，OpenAI 推出了兩款更便宜的模型，以半價的 Token 價格提供其前代模型的效能，並將矛頭指向 Anthropic's 較昂貴的產品。不過，獨立分析發現實際智慧程度幾無提升，而且 OpenAI 可能沒料到 Anthropic's 會同時推出 Opus 5.5。這篇名為 OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna cut prices in half but barely move the needle on performance 的文章最先發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: A tiny software layer from lab-grown neurons promises faster, cheaper AI video
items_all.summary: The Biological Computing Co. wants to team up with AWS to sell a text-to-video model that's supposed to run five times faster and 80 percent cheaper thanks to a software layer derived from real nerve cells. The tiny layer adds less than 0.1 percent to the base model, but the startup won't say which model that is. The article A tiny software layer from lab-grown neurons promises faster, cheaper AI video appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: The Biological Computing Co. 希望與 AWS 合作銷售一款文字轉影片模型，據稱由於採用了源自真實神經細胞的軟體層，其運行速度可快上五倍，成本更可降低 80%。這個微小的軟體層對基礎模型的影響不到 0.1%，但這家新創公司拒絕透露那是哪一個模型。這篇名為 A tiny software layer from lab-grown neurons promises faster, cheaper AI video 的文章最先發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Xiaomi's affordable flagship AI leads the open models, and Anthropic says Claude helped get it there
items_all.summary: With MiMo-V2.6-Pro, Xiaomi moves to the top of the openly available AI models and drastically undercuts the competition on price. What makes that possible is massive reinforcement learning that cost $2.62 million. But the success comes with a catch: Anthropic accuses the company of siphoning off training data from Claude. The article Xiaomi's affordable flagship AI leads the open models, and Anthropic says Claude helped get it there appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 隨著 MiMo-V2.6-Pro 的推出，小米躍居公開可用 AI 模型的頂尖地位，並以極低的價格大幅擊敗競爭對手。這一切得以實現，歸功於耗資 262 萬美元的大規模強化學習。但成功背後也有代價：Anthropic 指控該公司從 Claude 竊取訓練資料。這篇題為「小米平價旗艦 AI 領先開源模型，Anthropic 稱 Claude 助其登上頂峰」的文章首先發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: OpenAI says its internal model solved over 100 long-standing math problems after just a month of training
items_all.summary: OpenAI says a new internal model solved more than 100 open math problems after just a month of training. Facing criticism from mathematicians, the company is backing an independent advisory group at the Institute for Advanced Study. But OpenAI has excluded its research pace from the group's advisory role. The article OpenAI says its internal model solved over 100 long-standing math problems after just a month of training appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示，其全新的內部模型在經過僅一個月的訓練後，便解決了 100 多個未解的數學難題。面對來自數學家的批評，該公司正在支持位於高等研究院的一個獨立諮詢小組。不過，OpenAI 將其研究進度排除在該小組的諮詢職責之外。OpenAI報導稱其內部模型在僅僅一個月的訓練後就解決了 100 多個長期存在的數學問題，該報導最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: 【AI轉型實戰上篇】玉山GENIE每月處理14億Token，模型調用成本不到5萬元
items_all.summary: 今年9月底，玉山銀行即將推出第三代GENIE，作為內部統一AI入口，全面導入Agentic AI，要從AI輔助轉為人機協作，進一步邁向代理式銀行（Agentic Banking）願景發展。 GENIE從2024年初以合規防護為目標的OA智能助手1.0版，演進到如今主打規模化的2.0版，每個月Token用量已突破14億個，超過三分之一的員工經常使用，單月模型調用成本卻不到臺幣5萬元。 GENIE是玉山自行研發的OA智能助理，2024年1月正式推出1.0，該年9月升級到2.0，2026年9月即將邁向3.0。(圖片來源：玉山金控)

items_all.title: Meta patches Muse exploit that let attackers control the AI agent
items_all.summary: Meta has issued a patch for its Muse macOS app following the discovery of a zero-day vulnerability that could allow someone to take control of the AI agent. The bug found by security researcher Patrick Wardle utilized an undocumented Muse setting that enabled potential attackers running local code to redirect transcription processing from Meta's servers […]
items_all.summary_zh: 在發現一個可能允許他人控制 AI 代理的零日漏洞後，Meta 已針對其 Muse macOS 應用程式發布修補程式。安全研究員 Patrick Wardle 發現的此錯誤利用了一個未記錄的 Muse 設定，該設定使執行本機程式碼的潛在攻擊者能夠將轉錄處理重新導向至 Meta's 伺服器 […]

items_all.title: 小米MiMo-V2. 6 發佈： 46 分登頂開源之巔，把性價比砍成一道斬殺線
items_all.summary: 9月22日，小米發佈新一代大模型MiMo-V2.6，推出Pro和Flash兩個原生全模態版本。Pro版在Artificial Analysis綜合智能指數上拿到46分，超越Kimi K3和Qwen3.8Max，成爲當前最強開源模型；但小米坦言，與Claude Fable5.1、GPT-6Astra等頂級閉源模型仍有差距。

items_all.title: 小米發佈並開源 MiMo-V2.6:AA 智能指數46分登頂最強開源模型
items_all.summary: 小米9月22日發佈開源全模態模型MiMo-V2.6系列（Pro/Flash），基於可驗證任務擴展強化學習，探索遞歸自我改進。Pro版在Artificial Analysis綜合智能指數獲46分，超越Kimi K3與Qwen3.8Max，成最強開源模型；多數Agent基準比肩Claude Opus5與GPT-5.6Sol，但與最強閉源仍有差距。兩款模型Live RL訓練不足6天，成本約85萬和262萬元。

items_all.title: 日本擬最早 2027 年在國際空間站辦 AI 機器人競賽，培養下一代太空工程師
items_all.summary: 日本計劃最早2027年在國際空間站舉辦AI機器人競賽，由東京太空AI機器人協會SAIRA組織。參賽團隊將用AI控制站內機器人，旨在培養下一代太空工程師。該協會今年7月成立，將與大學、研究機構及企業合作，推動太空探索、AI、機器人和模擬等領域發展。

items_all.title: llm-typesafe 0.1a0
items_all.summary: Release: llm-typesafe 0.1a0 I built this new plugin for LLM to add support for TypeSafe AI's new Jev model . Install it like this: llm install llm-typesafe Then set an API key ( get one here , the waitlist seems to move pretty fast): llm keys set typesafe # Paste key And now you can ask yes/no "noul" questions like this: llm -m jev 'Please refund my last payment.' \ -s 'Does this message explicitly request a refund?' Output: {"type": "noul", "noul": 0.99} Or choice questions like this: cat message.txt | llm -m jev \ -s ' Which team should handle this message? If billing and technical issues both occur, choose billing. ' \ -o answer_type choice \ -o criteria ' { "billing":"Charges, invoices, payments, or refunds", "technical":"Problems installing or using the product", "other":"Neither category fits" } ' Or scoring questions like this: cat report.txt | llm -m jev \ -s ' How reproducible is the problem described in this report? ' \ -o answer_type score \ -o criteria ' [ "No reproduction instructions", "Some instructions, but important steps are missing", "Complete steps with expected and actual results" ] ' See the README for more details. Tags: projects , llm , jev
items_all.summary_zh: 版本釋出：llm-typesafe 0.1a0 我為 LLM 建立了這個新外掛程式，以增加對 TypeSafe AI 的新 Jev 模型的支援。安裝方式如下：llm install llm-typesafe 接著設定 API 金鑰（在此處取得，候診名單似乎推進得蠻快的）：llm keys set typesafe # 貼上金鑰 接著你就可以詢問是/否「noul」類型問題，例如：llm -m jev 'Please refund my last payment.' \ -s 'Does this message explicitly request a refund?' 輸出：{"type": "noul", "noul": 0.99} 或者選擇題類型問題，例如：cat message.txt | llm -m jev \ -s ' Which team should handle this message? If billing and technical issues both occur, choose billing. ' \ -o answer_type choice \ -o criteria ' { "billing":"Charges, invoices, payments, or refunds", "technical":"Problems installing or using the product", "other":"Neither category fits" } ' 或者評分題類型問題，例如：cat report.txt | llm -m jev \ -s ' How reproducible is the problem described in this report? ' \ -o answer_type score \ -o criteria ' [ "No reproduction instructions", "Some instructions, but important steps are missing", "Complete steps with expected and actual results" ] ' 更多詳細資訊請參閱 README。標籤：專案、llm、jev

items_all.title: Jev introduces a new shape of LLM - System One, aka Decision Models
items_all.summary: Last week TypeSafe AI unveiled Jev , their first example of a new category of model that they are calling "System One models" (I'm with Maggie Appleton, I think "decision models" is a better name for these). Jev is an interesting variant on the usual LLM format: it still accepts text inputs, but instead of text output it returns floating point numbers corresponding to categories, yes/no questions, ratings, and associated confidence scores. TypeSafe describe Jev like this: Think of Jev as a frontier-intelligence function call: unstructured state in, typed probabilistic decisions out. It's also very fast, and really cheap . Regular LLMs are priced in terms of input and output tokens, with output generally charged at significantly higher rates. Jev charges only for input - output is free - and the input price of their first model is $0.042 per million tokens - cheaper even than OpenAI's GPT-5 Nano ($0.05/million). Jev lets you ask questions about text or semi-structured data. You compose a "state" object containing a string, array of strings, or set of name-value pairs - this might describe an article, or a customer, or any other kind of record. You then send that to their API with one or more questions, and get a reply back for each. You can ask three kinds of questions: Yes/No questions, which Jev calls "Noul" questions - their CEO confirmed on Hacker News that this is short for Bernoulli, from the Bernoulli distribution . items_all.title: Cloudflare Python Workers are now generally available
items_all.summary: Cloudflare Python Workers are now generally available After a two year preview, Cloudflare's support for running Python code in their server-side Workers platform is now stable: "Python is now a first-class, fully supported language on the Cloudflare Developer Platform". A neat thing about this is how it works. Cloudflare are running Python compiled to WebAssembly via Pyodide in their V8-based workerd runtime. This comes with some limitations, documented here - most notably both multiprocessing and threading are non-functional in the WebAssembly VM. One particularly interesting detail of this is the local development environment story - their pywrangler development tool (confusingly packaged as workers-py on PyPI) runs a full local simulation of their stack, including executing code with Pyodide in WebAssembly in V8 in a 123MB workerd binary, which for me ended up in node_modules/@cloudflare/workerd-darwin-arm64/bin/workerd . Python Workers represent a significant investment in the wider Python ecosystem by Cloudflare. The release announcement is credited to Gyeongjae Choi, Dominik Picheta, and Hood Chatham - Gyeongjae and Hood are both Pyodide core maintainers. Via Hacker News Tags: python , cloudflare , webassembly , pyodide

items_all_raw.summary: With GPT-6 Sol and Luna, OpenAI adds two cheaper models that deliver their predecessors' performance at half the token price and take aim at Anthropic's pricier offerings. Independent analyses find little gain in actual intelligence, though, and OpenAI likely didn't see Anthropic's simultaneous launch of Opus 5.5 coming. The article OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna cut prices in half but barely move the needle on performance appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 透過 GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna，OpenAI 推出了兩款更便宜的模型，以半價的 Token 價格提供其前代模型的效能，並將矛頭指向 Anthropic's 較昂貴的產品。不過，獨立分析發現實際智慧程度幾無提升，而且 OpenAI 可能沒料到 Anthropic's 會同時推出 Opus 5.5。這篇名為 OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna cut prices in half but barely move the needle on performance 的文章最先發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: llm-typesafe 0.1a0
items_all_raw.summary: Release: llm-typesafe 0.1a0 I built this new plugin for LLM to add support for TypeSafe AI's new Jev model . Install it like this: llm install llm-typesafe Then set an API key ( get one here , the waitlist seems to move pretty fast): llm keys set typesafe # Paste key And now you can ask yes/no "noul" questions like this: llm -m jev 'Please refund my last payment.' \ -s 'Does this message explicitly request a refund?' Output: {"type": "noul", "noul": 0.99} Or choice questions like this: cat message.txt | llm -m jev \ -s ' Which team should handle this message? If billing and technical issues both occur, choose billing. ' \ -o answer_type choice \ -o criteria ' { "billing":"Charges, invoices, payments, or refunds", "technical":"Problems installing or using the product", "other":"Neither category fits" } ' Or scoring questions like this: cat report.txt | llm -m jev \ -s ' How reproducible is the problem described in this report? ' \ -o answer_type score \ -o criteria ' [ "No reproduction instructions", "Some instructions, but important steps are missing", "Complete steps with expected and actual results" ] ' See the README for more details. items_all_raw.title: Xiaomi's affordable flagship AI leads the open models, and Anthropic says Claude helped get it there
items_all_raw.summary: With MiMo-V2.6-Pro, Xiaomi moves to the top of the openly available AI models and drastically undercuts the competition on price. What makes that possible is massive reinforcement learning that cost $2.62 million. But the success comes with a catch: Anthropic accuses the company of siphoning off training data from Claude. The article Xiaomi's affordable flagship AI leads the open models, and Anthropic says Claude helped get it there appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all_raw.title: 【AI轉型實戰上篇】玉山銀行GENIE每月處理14億Token，模型調用成本不到5萬元
items_all_raw.summary: 也可參考【AI轉型實戰下篇】玉山打造全行AI代理入口，首度揭露新一代GENIE關鍵Agentic技術框架 今年9月底，玉山銀行即將推出第三代GENIE，作為內部統一AI入口，全面導入Agentic AI，要從AI輔助轉為人機協作，進一步邁向代理式銀行（Agentic Banking）願景發展。
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 今年9月底，玉山銀行即將推出第三代GENIE，作為內部統一AI入口，全面導入Agentic AI，要從AI輔助轉為人機協作，進一步邁向代理式銀行（Agentic Banking）願景發展。 GENIE從2024年初以合規防護為目標的OA智能助手1.0版，演進到如今主打規模化的2.0版，每個月Token用量已突破14億個，超過三分之一的員工經常使用，單月模型調用成本卻不到臺幣5萬元。 GENIE是玉山自行研發的OA智能助理，2024年1月正式推出1.0，該年9月升級到2.0，2026年9月即將邁向3.0。(圖片來源：玉山金控)

items_all_raw.title: 小米MiMo-V2. 6 發佈： 46 分登頂開源之巔，把性價比砍成一道斬殺線
items_all_raw.summary: 9月22日，小米發佈新一代大模型MiMo-V2.6，推出Pro和Flash兩個原生全模態版本。Pro版在Artificial Analysis綜合智能指數上拿到46分，超越Kimi K3和Qwen3.8Max，成爲當前最強開源模型；但小米坦言，與Claude Fable5.1、GPT-6Astra等頂級閉源模型仍有差距。

items_all_raw.title: 小米發佈並開源 MiMo-V2.6:AA 智能指數46分登頂最強開源模型
items_all_raw.summary: 小米9月22日發佈開源全模態模型MiMo-V2.6系列（Pro/Flash），基於可驗證任務擴展強化學習，探索遞歸自我改進。Pro版在Artificial Analysis綜合智能指數獲46分，超越Kimi K3與Qwen3.8Max，成最強開源模型；多數Agent基準比肩Claude Opus5與GPT-5.6Sol，但與最強閉源仍有差距。兩款模型Live RL訓練不足6天，成本約85萬和262萬元。

items_all_raw.title: 日本擬最早 2027 年在國際空間站辦 AI 機器人競賽，培養下一代太空工程師
items_all_raw.summary: 日本計劃最早2027年在國際空間站舉辦AI機器人競賽，由東京太空AI機器人協會SAIRA組織。參賽團隊將用AI控制站內機器人，旨在培養下一代太空工程師。該協會今年7月成立，將與大學、研究機構及企業合作，推動太空探索、AI、機器人和模擬等領域發展。

items_all_raw.title: Jev introduces a new shape of LLM - System One, aka Decision Models
items_all_raw.summary: Last week TypeSafe AI unveiled Jev , their first example of a new category of model that they are calling "System One models" (I'm with Maggie Appleton, I think "decision models" is a better name for these). Jev is an interesting variant on the usual LLM format: it still accepts text inputs, but instead of text output it returns floating point numbers corresponding to categories, yes/no questions, ratings, and associated confidence scores. TypeSafe describe Jev like this: Think of Jev as a frontier-intelligence function call: unstructured state in, typed probabilistic decisions out. It's also very fast, and really cheap . Regular LLMs are priced in terms of input and output tokens, with output generally charged at significantly higher rates. Jev charges only for input - output is free - and the input price of their first model is $0.042 per million tokens - cheaper even than OpenAI's GPT-5 Nano ($0.05/million). Jev lets you ask questions about text or semi-structured data. You compose a "state" object containing a string, array of strings, or set of name-value pairs - this might describe an article, or a customer, or any other kind of record. You then send that to their API with one or more questions, and get a reply back for each. items_all_raw.title: Cloudflare Python Workers are now generally available
items_all_raw.summary: Cloudflare Python Workers are now generally available After a two year preview, Cloudflare's support for running Python code in their server-side Workers platform is now stable: "Python is now a first-class, fully supported language on the Cloudflare Developer Platform". A neat thing about this is how it works. Cloudflare are running Python compiled to WebAssembly via Pyodide in their V8-based workerd runtime. This comes with some limitations, documented here - most notably both multiprocessing and threading are non-functional in the WebAssembly VM. One particularly interesting detail of this is the local development environment story - their pywrangler development tool (confusingly packaged as workers-py on PyPI) runs a full local simulation of their stack, including executing code with Pyodide in WebAssembly in V8 in a 123MB workerd binary, which for me ended up in node_modules/@cloudflare/workerd-darwin-arm64/bin/workerd . Python Workers represent a significant investment in the wider Python ecosystem by Cloudflare. The release announcement is credited to Gyeongjae Choi, Dominik Picheta, and Hood Chatham - Gyeongjae and Hood are both Pyodide core maintainers. Via Hacker News Tags: python , cloudflare , webassembly , pyodide
